test_title: PYST 47: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which music-composer duo was honoured with the National Lata Mangeshkar Award for the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Anand- Milind**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** music composer duo Anand-Milind was honoured with the National Lata Mangeshkar Award for the year 2020**
 
• The **award was presented to Anand-Milind on September 28, 2020, at the birthplace of Lata Mangeshkar** in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The award is given annually by the Madhya Pradesh Culture Department to promote excellence in light music.
 
• **The award includes a cash prize of Rs two lakh and a citation.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other recipients of the award include**:

 
 
• Shailendra Singh: Received the award in 2019 
 
• Kumar Sanu: Received the award in 2021 
 
• Uttam Singh: Received the award in 2022 
 
• K. S. Chithra: Received the award in 2023 
 
• Narendra Modi: Received the first Lata Deenanath Mangeshkar Award in 2022 
 
• Amitabh Bachchan: Received the Lata Deenanath Mangeshkar Award in 2024
